title: Cam Skattebo done with backflip celebration in wake of Aidan Hutchinson injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cam Skattebo done with backflip celebration in wake of Aidan Hutchinson injury
sources.description: Cam Skattebo has seen enough. The Giants RB says he is ending his backflip celebration in the wake of Aidan Hutchinson's season-ending injury.
